subject: Rate & model roster for GreenThread pilot
messages:
From: Lisa Chang <lisa@greenthread.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: GreenThread Procurement <procurement@greenthread.ai>, Markus Vogel <markus@greenthread.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Jul 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rate & model roster for GreenThread pilot

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. GreenThread is preparing a short pilot (6–8 weeks) to evaluate using Redwood hosted API for our customer support and summarization flows. Before we lock the pilot scope I need a concise baseline:

- Standard per-1M token rates (input / output) for hosted API across the current model families you recommend for conversational and summarization workloads.
- Any pilot/POC discount you typically offer and the process to get approval.
- A one-page list of supported models (name + typical latency tier) and any restrictions (e.g., safety, PII-handling).

High level about us: product support volume ~1.2M input tokens / month and ~3.5M output tokens (mostly short-form responses, avg 45 tokens). We'll start in US region and may expand APAC later.

Goal: get a simple ratecard and a recommended model shortlist so our procurement can start paperwork. If you can send something by EOD tomorrow it would be ideal — procurement wants a ballpark for the pilot budget.

Thanks,
Lisa Chang
Head of Integrations
GreenThread AI

Attachments: none
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chang <lisa@greenthread.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Aug 2029 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rate & model roster for GreenThread pilot

Hi Lisa — great to meet you yesterday. Quick response below with a clean baseline and a recommended shortlist; attaching a compact ratecard PDF and a starter MAP for pilots.

Baseline hosted API IO rates (standard tier, US region):
- Small / low-latency family (best for short-form responses): $0.40 per 1M input tokens, $1.20 per 1M output tokens
- Medium / balanced family (recommended for mixed dialog + summarization): $0.75 per 1M input, $2.25 per 1M output
- Large / high-quality family (long-form summarization & instruction-heavy): $1.60 per 1M input, $4.80 per 1M output

Notes:
- Rates above are list (no commitment). We auto-bill usage per month; we also show aggregated token breakdown in the Console.
- For pilot pilots (<=3 months and <10M total tokens), we commonly approve a 30% pilot discount on output charges and 15% on input charges, subject to a brief internal review.
- Supported models: see attached one-pager (shortlist: rdx-small-v2, rdx-mid-v1, rdx-large-q4f16). Latency tiers indicated in the doc; rdx-small is sub-150ms median, rdx-mid ~200–350ms, rdx-large ~350–700ms depending on sequence length.
- Safety and PII: hosted API supports automated redaction hooks and customer-managed retention settings; enterprise plans can enable stricter logs and KMS.

Quick question to help qualify the discount path: can you confirm expected pilot total tokens (input+output) over the 6–8 week pilot and whether GreenThread will sign a short MSA or needs a purchase order only? If you share that, I can loop in our sales ops for a formal pilot quote.

Next steps: I'll schedule a 20-minute follow-up for Friday to walk procurement through the ratecard and pilot term options — unless you prefer to handle via email.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Redwood_hosted_ratecard_v3.pdf, GreenThread_pilot_MAP.xlsx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Aug 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: [Internal] GreenThread pilot discount ask

Mateo / Neha —

Forwarding Lisa's ask and your proposed baseline. Quick notes:
- Pilot token estimate will determine discount band. If they land ~5–10M total over pilot, 20–30% on output is reasonable; 30% might be OK for early-stage/proof-of-concept if product-team commitment exists.
- Approvals: Sales Ops signs off up to 25% output discount; above that requires my sign-off + AP review.
- I'd like to keep input discount conservative (10–15%) to preserve marginal economics.

Can you confirm:
1) Expected 6–8 week total tokens (mateo to confirm from Lisa)
2) Whether GreenThread needs an MSA (we prefer MSA) or PO-only

If they want the 30% you mentioned, I'll clear the extra 5% on a patch basis if the pilot includes a named performance SLA and a committed timeline to a paid pilot conversion.

- Lauren
VP Sales - Strategic Accounts

Subject: Re: Rate & model roster for GreenThread pilot

Hi Lisa — quick update after internal alignment. We approved a pilot package tailored to GreenThread. Summary below (final numbers attached in the PDF).

Approved pilot pricing (6-week pilot, estimated 6.2M total tokens):
- Recommended model: rdx-mid-v1 (balanced quality/latency) for the majority of calls; rdx-small-v2 for high-volume short responses.
- Pricing (pilot discounted):
  • rdx-mid-v1: input $0.6375 per 1M tokens (15% off list), output $1.6875 per 1M tokens (25% off list)
  • rdx-small-v2: input $0.34 per 1M tokens (15% off), output $0.90 per 1M tokens (25% off)

Pilot conditions:
- Pilot period: 6 weeks starting on the signed start date.
- Usage cap: soft cap at 10M total tokens; overage billed at list less the approved pilot discount band.
- Documentation: MSA preferred; we can accept a PO for smaller pilots but MSA accelerates enablement (data controls, SSO, KMS notes).
- Deliverables: 1) Ratecard (attached PDF), 2) MAP with onboarding checklist (attached), 3) a short implementation call to review keys and Console dashboards.

If that looks OK, can you confirm:
- Signer for MSA (procurement contact) and target start date (we can push the start date to accommodate internal reviews)
- Any region constraints (you mentioned US today; if APAC needed in pilot we should plan model selection/latency expectations)

Thanks — I'll attach the formal pilot quote (PDF) and a DocuSign link once we get the PO/MSA confirmation.

Best,
Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
